companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Roland Berger is a global strategy consultancy with offices in more than thirty countries, advising clients across industry and the public sector.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As a summer intern you will join a project team in London for ten weeks and work on a live client engagement. You will research markets, build analyses in Excel and PowerPoint, and help shape recommendations that are presented to senior client staff.

  • Gather and analyse market and company data
  • Interview experts and summarise what you learn
  • Prepare slides for workshops and steering meetings

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
The internship is for students in the final years of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in any subject.

  • Excellent academic record
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English; another European language is a plus

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text: Please upload your CV and transcripts. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
